newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme sees some cystic fibrosis benefit.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme sees some cystic fibrosis benefit.

text.p: Genzyme General, a division of Genzyme Corp, said on Thursday that sales of its cystic fibrosis testing product may be boosted by the recommendation of a National Institutes of Health panel that all couples planning a pregnancy be offered a test for this condition.
The panel also said the tests should be covered by insurance companies.

Genzyme's multiple allele-specific diagnostic assay technology can simultaneously analyze hundreds of patient DNA samples for more than 100 mutations on one or more genes in a single test, the company said.
Genzyme said it expects that last week's NIH panel recommendation, if adopted, will lead to a large increase in the number of these tests performed.
Genzyme also reported first quarter financial results on Thursday, including fully diluted net income of $0.27 per share compared to $0.26 for the same period a year ago.
